require 'net-ldap'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module EncryptedStorage
  ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm'

  def self.encryption_key
    @key ||= ENV.fetch('STORAGE_KEY') { SecureRandom.hex(16) }
  end

  def self.encrypt(plaintext)
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
    cipher.encrypt
    iv = cipher.random_iv
    cipher.key = [encryption_key].pack('H*')
    cipher.auth_data = 'ldap-worker-v2'
    encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
    tag = cipher.auth_tag
    Base64.strict_encode64(iv + tag + encrypted)
  end

  def self.decrypt(ciphertext)
    raw = Base64.strict_decode64(ciphertext)
    decipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
    decipher.decrypt
    decipher.iv = raw[0, 12]
    decipher.auth_tag = raw[12, 16]
    decipher.key = [encryption_key].pack('H*')
    decipher.auth_data = 'ldap-worker-v2'
    decipher.update(raw[28..]) + decipher.final
  end
end

module LdapSanitizer
  SPECIAL_CHARS = ['\\', '*', '(', ')', "\x00"].freeze

  def self.escape_filter_value(value)
    return '' if value.nil?
    escaped = value.to_s.dup
    SPECIAL_CHARS.each do |char|
      hex = format('\\%02x', char.ord)
      escaped.gsub!(char, hex)
    end
    escaped
  end

  def self.escape_dn_component(value)
    return '' if value.nil?
    value.to_s.gsub(/([,\\#+<>;"=])/) { "\\#{$1}" }
  end
end

class LdapConnectionPool
  def initialize(config)
    @host = config[:host] || 'ldap.internal'
    @port = config[:port] || 636
    @base_dn = config[:base_dn] || 'dc=company,dc=com'
    @bind_dn = config[:bind_dn]
    @bind_password = config[:bind_password]
  end

  def with_connection
    ldap = Net::LDAP.new(
      host: @host,
      port: @port,
      encryption: { method: :simple_tls },
      auth: { method: :simple, username: @bind_dn, password: @bind_password }
    )
    raise "LDAP bind failed" unless ldap.bind
    yield ldap, @base_dn
  end
end

class UserSyncWorker
  attr_reader :pool, :logger

  def initialize(ldap_config, logger: nil)
    @pool = LdapConnectionPool.new(ldap_config)
    @logger = logger || Logger.new($stdout)
  end

  def perform(encrypted_payload)
    payload = JSON.parse(EncryptedStorage.decrypt(encrypted_payload))
    action = payload['action']
    case action
    when 'lookup'
      lookup_user(payload['criteria'])
    when 'sync_group'
      sync_group_members(payload['group_name'], payload['department'])
    when 'resolve_chain'
      resolve_manager_chain(payload['employee_id'], payload['traversal_attr'])
    else
      logger.warn("Unknown action: #{action}")
    end
  end

  private

  def lookup_user(criteria)
    field = criteria['field']
    value = criteria['value']
    allowed_fields = %w[uid mail employeeNumber cn sn givenName]
    unless allowed_fields.include?(field)
      raise ArgumentError, "Disallowed search field: #{field}"
    end
    safe_value = LdapSanitizer.escape_filter_value(value)
    filter = Net::LDAP::Filter.eq(field, safe_value)
    pool.with_connection do |ldap, base|
      ldap.search(base: base, filter: filter, return_result: true)
    end
  end

  def sync_group_members(group_name, department)
    safe_group = LdapSanitizer.escape_filter_value(group_name)
    safe_dept = LdapSanitizer.escape_filter_value(department)
    filter = Net::LDAP::Filter.eq('cn', safe_group) &
             Net::LDAP::Filter.eq('ou', safe_dept)
    pool.with_connection do |ldap, base|
      ldap.search(base: base, filter: filter, return_result: true)
    end
  end

  def resolve_manager_chain(employee_id, traversal_attr)
    safe_id = LdapSanitizer.escape_filter_value(employee_id)
    chain = []
    current_filter = Net::LDAP::Filter.eq('employeeNumber', safe_id)
    pool.with_connection do |ldap, base|
      5.times do
        results = ldap.search(base: base, filter: current_filter, return_result: true)
        break if results.nil? || results.empty?
        entry = results.first
        chain << entry.dn
        manager_ref = entry[traversal_attr]&.first
        break if manager_ref.nil? || manager_ref.empty?
        current_filter = build_traversal_filter(manager_ref, traversal_attr)
      end
    end
    chain
  end

  def build_traversal_filter(reference_value, attr_name)
    validated_attr = validate_attribute_name(attr_name)
    if reference_value.include?(',')
      dn_uid = extract_uid_from_dn(reference_value)
      Net::LDAP::Filter.eq('uid', LdapSanitizer.escape_filter_value(dn_uid))
    else
      Net::LDAP::Filter.eq(validated_attr, LdapSanitizer.escape_filter_value(reference_value))
    end
  end

  def extract_uid_from_dn(dn_string)
    dn_string.split(',').first.split('=').last
  end

  def validate_attribute_name(attr)
    if attr =~ /\A[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\-]*\z/
      attr
    else
      'manager'
    end
  end
end

class WorkerDispatcher
  def self.enqueue(action:, **params)
    payload = { 'action' => action }.merge(params.transform_keys(&:to_s))
    encrypted = EncryptedStorage.encrypt(payload.to_json)
    { job_id: SecureRandom.uuid, payload: encrypted }
  end
end
